name: Kot-Domovoj
source:
This is a story about Kot - a house spirit in the shape of a cat. It’s lost its owner and his powers leave him insensibly. It has to find a new owner to survive before they disappear. But what if he meets a lost kitten? Or a restless soul? Or a thirsting demon hunting the weakend hero’s energy remains?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2250230/House_spirit_cat/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于科特（Kot）的故事——科特是一只猫形状的家庭精灵。它失去了主人，他的力量也让他失去知觉。它必须在它们消失之前找到新的主人才能生存。但如果他遇到一只迷路的小猫怎么办？还是不安分的灵魂？或者是一个饥渴的恶魔正在猎杀被削弱的英雄的剩余能量？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2250230/House_spirit_cat/]Steam[/url]]
